videos.title: Ferrari
videos.description: Ex-Formula 1 racer Enzo Ferrari launches his team into the perilous 1,000-mile Mille Miglia race. Sky Original film from Michael Mann with Adam Driver and Penélope Cruz.

videos.title: True Grit
videos.description: When her father is murdered, young Hailee Steinfeld hires US Marshal Jeff Bridges to track down the killer. Coen Brothers Western with Matt Damon. Violence/flashing images.

videos.title: Lee
videos.description: Discover Lee Miller, the war photographer who heroically documented the truth of the Nazi regime. Sky Original film with Kate Winslet.

videos.description: A WWII psychiatrist evaluates Nazi leaders before the Nuremberg trials, growing obsessed with understanding evil as he bonds with Hermann Göring.

videos.description: Tom Cruise stars as a struggling sports agent who falls for single mum Renee Zellweger. Top romantic comedy with Cuba Gooding Jr. Language.
